svg.aria-label: The FoldFlow pipeline: one target structure in PDB format fans out to three design indices, passes through backbone generation by RFdiffusion or BoltzGen producing PDB backbones, then sequence design by ProteinMPNN or LigandMPNN producing FASTA sequences, then validation by AlphaFold 2 or AlphaFold 3 producing predicted PDB structures with JSON scores. Each stage runs both of its tools on every item and mixes their outputs into one channel.
svg.title: FoldFlow pipeline map
svg.text: One target structure in, 48 predicted structures out: PDB backbones become FASTA sequences, folded back to PDB with JSON scores.
Every stage runs all of its tools on every item; the vertical bars mix their outputs into one channel that the next stage picks up.
